status: complete: two gear points per leveling level (the lab's standard gear and each level's best Forever set), raid, heal and tank values

spell_hit.note: Spell miss by the target's level minus yours (bosses +3). No 1% minimum miss: hit counts up to the whole miss chance and nothing above. Count talent and racial hit (the character's current spell hit). Leveling: the same-level row (4%); raids: 17%. Client tooltip CR_*_HIT_CAP_TOOLTIP.

melee_hit.note: Special attacks and a single weapon's swings; a dual-wielder's white swings miss 19 points more (27% vs bosses). Client tooltip: 8% melee/ranged and 27% dual wielding against raid bosses, 5% against your level.

expertise.note: Expertise lowers the target's dodge and parry alike: worth its value until dodge is gone (parry too when you stand in front, as solo leveling and tanking do).

defense.note: A boss crits a tank 5.6% at 300 defense skill, 0.04% less per point: 440 at 60. Below 60: 5 x level + 140 against a boss three levels up.

spell_penetration.note: Spell Piercing: past the target's resistance it is bonus damage, on average P / (P + 8 x your level + 19) of a spell's damage, a tenth on DoT ticks, none on Holy (wowsims/forever issue #76, 138 Forever combat logs). Leveling values from the fight lab (2026-11-13), raid values from the simulator.

haste.note: 10 rating = 1% faster casts and swings at every level. Whether haste shortens the global cooldown is open (the simulator says yes for spells, the client's Nature's Grace suggests no; _reference/forever-stats.md row 7).

not_scored.health_regen: not measured (the fight lab's eating time does not read health regeneration from gear)
not_scored.effects: Use, Equip-proc, chance-on-hit and set-bonus effects are not scored (static stats only); relics, idols, librams and totems with only an effect score 0 and say so

note: Class keys: the client's classFile, lowercased. Leveling: values are seconds per kill one point saves (fight lab), per level (every 5 from 10 to 60: interpolate; below 10 the level-10 numbers) and per gear point. Two gear points per level: 'standard' (the lab's standard gear) and 'best Forever set'; each carries item_stats, the set's summed item stats in these keys (hit and expertise left out). Place the character between them by its own items (preferred): share = delta(standard values, standard item_stats, your summed item stats without hit and expertise) / delta(standard values, standard item_stats, best item_stats), clamped 0-1, computed at each of the two levels around yours; values and seconds_per_kill = standard + share x (best - standard). Fallback: interpolate on the character's own total of the level's unit stat, clamped. Each level says caster (true: the spell hit cap; false: the melee cap). An item's gain = sum of (new - old) x value, its share of faster kills = gain / seconds_per_kill. Raid, heal and tank values: worth per point with the unit stat = 1 (1 Spell Power, attack power, healing power or Stamina); an item's share = its score change over the score of everything equipped. Spell lines map one to one: '+N Spell Power' -> spell_power, '+N Spell Damage' -> spell_damage, '+N Spell Healing' -> spell_healing, '+N Frost Spell Damage' -> frost_damage; count every line the tooltip lists (healing items list a third as a separate Spell Damage line). mp5 = the client's mana regeneration. Ratings per rating point, keyed by the stat keys (flat at every level). Hit counts only up to the cap (caps; the character's current hit with the replaced item's taken off): leveling hit_rating, raid hit_rating_below_cap. Rings and trinkets: the new item replaces the one that scores less. Values are clamped at 0. test_vectors: reproduce 'expected' within 'tolerance'. Models of the beta (fight lab, raid simulator, healer lab), not measurements.
